logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water partition coefficient (logD7.4 for 1 and logP7.4 for 3 and 4) was determined using the shake-flask method based on the amounts of complex distributed in the two phases. 10 μL of complex (10 mg/mL), 750 μL of saturated n-octanol and 750 μL of saturated PBS-buffered (pH = 7.4, [PO4 3-] = 10 mM and [NaCl] = 15 M) were mixed in an Eppendorf. The solutions were shaken first on a laboratory vortexer for 15 min and then were centrifuged (3000 rpm, 5 min.) to separate the two phases. The absorbance of each phase was recorded and then the partition coefficient was calculated (log{[complex]o/ [complex]w) as a mean of three triplicates.
